resources.string: Review powerful app permissions on this device. This audit reads access settings only; it never reads your screen or notifications and never changes another app’s permissions.
HIGH RISK means powerful access, not proof of spyware. Legitimate screen readers, work administrators and companion apps may need it. Review access you do not recognize.

Overlay entries distinguish Android’s allowed, denied and unavailable app-op states. Permission declarations alone are not treated as enabled. Some devices do not expose another app’s grant state.

Compare enabled accessibility, administrators and notification readers about every 6 hours. Snapshots stay encrypted on this device. The first successful check establishes a silent baseline; Android may defer background work.

Overlay access can display content over other apps and may obscure their controls.
Urgent local threat alerts with a five-second alarm when enabled.
This installed app matched a known malware hash. Avoid opening it. Uninstall it using Android’s confirmation screen. SafeMobile has not quarantined or removed this installed app.
App removal always requires your confirmation in Android. SafeMobile does not silently uninstall apps.

Opt in to urgent notifications and a five-second siren at maximum alarm volume for confirmed malware. Opening SafeMobile or dismissing an incident stops the siren. Android sound and Do Not Disturb settings may limit audio.
Android 14+ controls full-screen access. You may enable it in system settings for urgent incident notifications. If you leave it off, SafeMobile uses a high-priority notification. This is optional.

No local match does not prove a file is safe. The signed hash engine stays disabled until a trusted signing key and a vetted production database are configured. A limited offline DEX rule subset runs when verified bundled rules load; machine learning remains disabled. Heuristics can produce false alarms. Metrics below are not measured.
